title: GuardDuty Evasion Chain
description: An attacker with GuardDuty management permissions performs a series of actions to evade detection. They use guardduty:UpdateDetector to disable the detector or reduce its sensitivity. They add attacker IPs to trusted IP lists via guardduty:CreateIPSet and guardduty:UpdateIPSet so that activity from those IPs does not generate findings. They create or update filters via guardduty:CreateFilter and guardduty:UpdateFilter to suppress specific finding types. This chain blinds security monitoring to the attacker's subsequent activities.

steps.context: Add attacker IPs to trusted list
